updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging in the Purview portal will now provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, making it easier for administrators to troubleshoot access issues and verify authorization outcomes. This improvement helps compliance teams maintain better oversight of who accessed Purview and what permissions were evaluated.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer, blocking risky transfers to untrusted cloud applications and generative AI platforms. This integration enables admins to enforce restrictive DLP actions across browsers, apps, APIs, and add-ins beyond traditional Microsoft 365 locations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is being increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to label and protect significantly more data at rest faster. This helps close labeling gaps and better prepare data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot integration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Scan Existing Files in SharePoint and OneDrive for Sensitive Information
updates.summary: A new capability will enable administrators to scan files at rest in SharePoint and OneDrive for Business to identify sensitive data without relying solely on auto-labeling of new content. This helps organizations discover and address existing compliance gaps in their data estates.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Grouping Modernization
updates.summary: The sensitivity labeling scheme is being simplified to use modern label groupings instead of hierarchical parent labels, improving how administrators organize and categorize their labels. This change makes label management more intuitive while reducing complexity in labeling configurations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: New readiness and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management provide security teams with enhanced visibility into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage. These tools help organizations assess their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot and prioritize remediation efforts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Protection Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on a user's dynamic insider risk level, preserving deleted emails and files when risk levels change. This helps organizations maintain compliance while automatically adjusting data protection posture.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations from Endpoint DLP Alerts
updates.summary: Security teams can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to quickly analyze exfiltrated content, with the system automatically gathering related files that triggered alerts for review. This streamlines incident investigation workflows for data loss events.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: A new per-policy coverage report enables admins to track auto-labeling enforcement progress by comparing actual labeled files against simulation results. The report identifies files labeled during enforcement and those not yet labeled, helping administrators understand labeling effectiveness and identify gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management – Reduce Temporary File Noise
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management is being enhanced to reduce false positives from temporary files automatically created by Windows, Office, and browsers during normal operations. This reduces alert fatigue and helps security teams focus on genuine insider risk signals.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Delete OneDrives and Mailboxes for Departing Employees
updates.summary: Administrators can now automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, maintaining regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This streamlines the offboarding process while ensuring former employee data is properly removed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Administrators can now create DLP policies to protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This extends data protection governance beyond the Microsoft ecosystem.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Inactive Mailbox Delay Hold Management
updates.summary: When removing the last hold from an inactive mailbox, Microsoft 365 now automatically applies a 30-day delay hold to prevent accidental deletion. Administrators can now manage these delay holds using Security & Compliance PowerShell to better control mailbox lifecycle.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Priority Cleanup for SharePoint and OneDrive Files
updates.summary: A new Priority Cleanup feature allows administrators to permanently delete selected SharePoint and OneDrive files after simulation, review, and approval, bypassing recycle bins so files are no longer discoverable. This provides better control over sensitive or obsolete data removal in large-scale compliance scenarios.
